candidates.description: This feature vector represents words denoting change, growth, or directional movement in magnitude or state.
This vector represents the concept of causing an effect, change, or consequence on something else.
This vector represents quantifying determiners and adjectives indicating indefinite plurality or quantity.
This vector represents various states of mental engagement, emotional focus, and psychological interest.
This vector represents active verbs indicating positive actions, improvements, or strategic initiatives.
This feature vector represents the concept of defining terms, providing examples, or establishing precise meanings.
This vector is related to abstract nouns representing logical factors, conditions, or attributes.
This vector represents commercial and economic entities, activities, and sectors.
These tokens represent the degree, magnitude, or intensity of a state, action, or change.
These tokens represent adverbs of frequency and general tendency indicating how often or to what extent an action occurs.
